Before preserving the checkpoint or accepting its finish line I independently recovered the original owner request and material later corrections from canonical source records. The outcome record preserves the original request verbatim, material explicit corrections, available references and timestamps, normalized result, required evidence and thresholds, known non-satisfying proxies and exact identity. I validated the checkpoint, acceptance criteria, completion boundary and supervisor frame against that source. Downstream contracts, checkpoints, review packets, supervisor verdicts and workflow states may refine it but cannot omit, weaken, replace or terminally bypass it without explicit owner decision. When source is unavailable or materially ambiguous, OUTCOME_AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED prevents root satisfaction while clearly useful reversible contributing work continues. Normalization cannot soften modality, remove thresholds, narrow scope or convert outcome into review readiness. Verbatim authority and explicit later corrections control until the owner resolves discrepancies. The owner correction governs conflicting contract-authority and terminal-integrity guidance.
